name: ide-r
author: lumine-code
description: Provide R language intelligence through languageserver.

serverPath.title: Rscript Path
serverPath.description: Path to Rscript. Leave empty to discover R from PATH, R_HOME or a standard installation.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Show a notification when the server or its runtime is missing.

features.title: Features
features.description: Choose which language-server features the editor uses.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show documentation and type information on hover.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show function parameters while entering a call.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Navigate to declarations, definitions and implementations.

references.title: Find References
references.description: Find the uses of a symbol.

callHierarchy.title: Call Hierarchy
callHierarchy.description: Inspect incoming and outgoing function calls.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Provide document and project symbols for navigation.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename symbols and update their references.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer fixes and refactorings for the current code.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Show parameter names and inferred types beside source code.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Highlight source code using the server's semantic information.

cranMirror.title: CRAN Mirror
cranMirror.description: Repository used when installing or updating the languageserver R package and its dependencies.

libraryPath.title: Library Path
libraryPath.description: Additional R package library. Leave empty to use the managed server library or the libraries known to R.

downloadMethod.title: R Download Method
downloadMethod.description: Method R uses to fetch CRAN package indexes and archives. Auto uses R's default; curl uses the system curl executable when direct R downloads are unavailable.

diagnosticsDelay.title: Diagnostics Delay
diagnosticsDelay.description: Seconds to debounce diagnostics after parsing.

parseDelay.title: Parse Delay
parseDelay.description: Seconds to debounce parsing after a source edit.

maxCompletions.title: Maximum Completions
maxCompletions.description: Maximum number of completion suggestions returned by the server.

richDocumentation.title: Rich Documentation
richDocumentation.description: Return enhanced Markdown documentation for hover and completion.

indexMode.title: Project Indexing
indexMode.description: Index workspace R scripts automatically, or restrict analysis to package files and open documents.

inlayHintsMinimumArguments.title: Inlay Hints Minimum Arguments
inlayHintsMinimumArguments.description: Minimum number of supplied arguments before parameter names are shown.
